raw.contribution_note: Per-object signed delta divided by 2417; fraction of net change may exceed 1 or be negative because other objects offset it. No object is removed from primary results.

owner.definition: Common GT directed face-pairs present in all three methods; 16-point bidirectional squared nearest-neighbor means summed, per-object mean/max then macro summary.

limitations: All means are macro averages over computable objects; missing counts retain the fixed intended cohort.
Geometry metrics are squared sampled distances, not maximum CAD tolerances or physical-edge matching.
Owner geometry covers only common GT directed face-pairs predicted by all three; missed/extra pairs and coverage are reported separately.
Exact-adjacency subsets are descriptive and do not establish loop/vertex topology correctness or causal explanations.
Historical source remains a prior frozen-encoder model; candidate/control checkpoint exposure matches but full run budgets and capacity do not.
Post geometry common subsets may contain invalid solids; geometry and native validity are separate.
